metric_definitions.embedding_mean_offdiagonal_cosine: Raw mean off-diagonal cosine over up to 2048 uniformly sampled real-item rows, seed 42; computed in float64 after excluding nonfinite rows or norms<=1e-12. Uses (||sum(unit_rows)||^2-N)/(N*(N-1)); requires N>=2. Directional similarity, not a calibrated collapse probability or evidence of HR failure.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score over finite nonpadding sequence/positive/negative positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank tenth percentile of those margins; null when no valid positions exist.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid margins below zero.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid margins below eps=0.5; score-scale dependent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Item categories unavailable; category lists intentionally empty. Position counts remain measured.

paired_recent_context.selection: Sorted string user IDs, seed-42 permutation; select at most 200 structurally eligible training users per category before inspecting scores. Nonfinite scoring cases are recorded without replacement and excluded from paired estimates; report selected and scored counts separately. Last training item is target; preceding history truncated once to model.maxlen. Requires at least three items.
paired_recent_context.scope: All prefix results are in-sample: fitting may already have used the reserved target. Earlier target occurrences remain and are flagged. No validation reproduction without exact authorized host candidates.
paired_recent_context.conditions: n=bounded length; k=min(5,(n-1)//2). Intact=history; suffix=last min(10,n); recent deletion=history[:n-1-k]+history[-1:]; old deletion=history[k:]; anchor deletion=history[:-1]. No backfill. Recent/old remove equal counts and preserve anchor; suffix is descriptive, and unchanged suffixes are unaffected. Anchor deletion changes readout item.
paired_recent_context.geometry: Left-pad each retained history and read greatest nonzero index. Compaction changes absolute positions and evidence jointly. Faithful geometry-preserving masking unavailable. Existing attention normalization remains fixed. Original aligned timestamps are recorded; this HSTU has no temporal input.
paired_recent_context.candidates: 99 unique uniform real-item negatives without replacement, excluding every training item, padding and reserved IDs. Identical 100 candidates across conditions. Rank=1+preceding count under descending score, ascending item ID ties; this diagnostic tie rule is not a claim about host ties.
paired_recent_context.effects: Hit=rank<=10; delta_rank=perturbed-intact rank; delta_hr=perturbed-intact hit. Top10 overlap=intersection with intact top10 divided by 10. All paired estimates use identical eligible users.
paired_recent_context.uncertainty: 2000 paired user bootstrap replicates, seed 42, same user indices across conditions; percentile 95% intervals. Conditional on fitted model, selected users and fixed candidates; excludes training-seed/candidate variation and repeated-selection optimism.
paired_recent_context.macro: aggregate_categories accepts four explicitly identified reports from this trial, resamples within each category and equally averages category means. Missing or empty categories yield unavailable, never zero imputation. Single-view reports contain no purported macro estimate.
paired_recent_context.timestamps: Span=max-min of surviving original timestamps. Numeric values retain source units; parseable ISO values use seconds. Missing or unparseable timestamps yield null spans.
paired_recent_context.cost: At most 200 attempted paired forward batches of five sequences, exactly at most ten consumed margin batches, and 2048 sampled embeddings per category. Nonfinite scores do not trigger replacement forwards. No SVD, fitted auxiliary predictor, checkpoint change, or score fusion.
paired_recent_context.rng_isolation: Python, NumPy global, Torch CPU and the model GPU RNG states are restored after diagnosis, including exceptions. Explicit independent loader generators or persistent worker state remain owned by the caller; use a dedicated diagnostic loader for those cases.
